checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-specs#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 is only partly fixed. The iOS 12 fallback in design.md:74 (Consequences), tasks.md:98 (task 6.3 **Fallback:**) and tasks.md:109 (Human follow-up H2) says to remove only 'the `useDayTrackTouchFallback` call and its `onClick` guard from `DayTrack.tsx`, together with the tests of the drag without Pointer Events'. It never says to revise the change's FR4/UX3 (and the no-Pointer-Events parts of FR1/M1/M5) in proposal.md, or the spec delta: specs/time-selection/spec.md:47 'On an engine without Pointer Events, a finger drag MUST work the same way: … follows the finger until it lifts wherever it goes, and keeps the page from scrolling'; the outline row 'finger on an engine without Pointer Events' of 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track'; 'A finger drag adds no selection when the finger lifts'; and FR4/UX3 in the implements comment at spec.md:51. If the fallback is applied, the archived stable spec and proposal would require behaviour that iOS 12 no longer has, and FR4/UX3 would have no implementing test, against .claude/rules/traceability.md: 'For every FR/NFR/UX in `proposal.md`, at least one implementing entity must exist in code or tests.' M1's '5 of 5 E2E drag scenarios' could no longer be met. Fix: in all three fallback texts (and Open Questions, proposal.md:131), add that before archive the operator also removes the no-Pointer-Events drag paragraph and scenarios from the spec delta and restates FR4/UX3, M1 and M5 as 'iOS 12 keeps tap-only selection', so the change's artifacts match the fallback task clause 3 allows.
